subject: Torch
text: A Torch costs 8 gold and illuminates caves for one space around the player in each direction.

evidence.quote:
A very cheap way to light up caves. It is only 8 gold but doesn't light
too well. You can only see for one space around you in each direction, where
Radiant lets you see for four blocks in each direction but then fades out.

subject: Wings
text: Wings cost 70 gold and transport the player directly to Tantagel Castle.

evidence.quote:
You
can fly directly home to Tantagel Castle with this if you get in a situation
where you don't think you can make it home alive or you just want to quit and
don't want to walk all the way back. They are rather expensive, 70 gold, but
you will never need them after Level 15.

subject: Grave of Garinham
text: A Cursed Belt is found in a treasure chest up a long narrow hallway in the Grave of Garinham.

evidence.quote:
Found in two places. The first, in the Grave of Garninham. It
shouldn't be too hard to find. It is in a treasure chest after you walk up a
long narrow hallway.

subject: Charlock Castle
text: A Cursed Belt is found on the bottom floor of Charlock Castle behind a locked door.

evidence.quote:
The second on the bottom floor of Charlock Castle where
all those treasure chests are, guarded by a locked door.

subject: Cursed Belt
text: A Cursed Belt sells for 180 gold at the tool shop.

evidence.quote:
Don't put it on. Sell
it at the tool shop for 180 gold.

subject: Mountain Cave
text: The Cursed Necklace (Death Necklace) is found at random in a bottom-floor chest in the Mountain Cave that normally contains 100-130 gold.

evidence.quote:
Found in the Mountain Cave. On the bottom floor, you will find a chest that
contains 100-130 gold. The cursed necklace is in that chest at random.

subject: Heal
text: The Heal spell is learned at Level 3 and costs 4 MP to cast.

evidence.quote:
Name of Spell: Heal
Level Learned: 3
MP Cost: 4
Description: This will be the first spell you will learn.

subject: Healmore
text: The Healmore spell is learned at Level 17, costs 10 MP, and restores almost 100 HP.

evidence.quote:
Name of Spell: Healmore
Level Learned: 17
MP Cost: 10
Description: Restores almost 100 MP.

subject: Hurt
text: The Hurt spell is learned at Level 4 and costs 2 MP.

evidence.quote:
Name of Spell: Hurt
Level Learned: 4
MP Cost: 2

subject: Hurtmore
text: The Hurtmore spell is learned at Level 19, costs 5 MP, and inflicts 60-70 HP of damage on some enemies.

evidence.quote:
Name of Spell: Hurtmore
Level Learned: 19
MP Cost: 5
Description: Very powerful spell, that can take 60-70 HP away on some enemies.

subject: Outside
text: The Outside spell is learned at Level 12, costs 6 MP, and transports the player outside of a cave.

evidence.quote:
Name of Spell: Outside
Level Learned: 12
MP Cost: 6
Description: If you are ever stuck inside a cave and don't think you have enough
energy to make it out alive, or don't want to even try because you are in a
hurry, than this is the spell for you. It will transport you outside the cave,
no matter where you are inside of it.

subject: Radiant
text: The Radiant spell is learned at Level 8, costs 3 MP, and illuminates four blocks in each direction before fading out.

evidence.quote: Radiant lets you see for four blocks in each direction but then fades out.

Name of Spell: Radiant
Level Learned: 8
MP Cost: 3
Description: Much more effective than the torch, but it costs 3 mp everytime you
use it and it eventually fades out.

subject: Return
text: The Return spell is learned at Level 13, costs 8 MP, and returns the player directly to Tantagel Castle from anywhere outside of caves.

evidence.quote:
Name of Spell: Return
Level Learned: 13
MP Cost: 8
Description: Lets you return directly to Tantagel Castle from anywhere in
Alfegard. It will not work from caves, however.

subject: Repel
text: The Repel spell is learned at Level 15, costs 2 MP, and functions like fairy water but does not work in caves or against enemies stronger than the player.

evidence.quote:
Name of Spell: Repel
Level Learned: 15
MP Cost: 2
Description: Very useful Spell. Does the same thing as fairy water, but you
don't have to pay anything for it and it only takes 2 MP to use it. It will not
work in caves or on enemies stronger than you

subject: Sleep
text: The Sleep spell is learned at Level 7 and costs 2 MP, but Demon Knights are not affected by it.

evidence.quote:
Name of Spell: Sleep
Level Learned: 7
MP Cost: 2
Description: When you get this spell, the game will be a hell of a lot easier.
You will be able to fight bigger and tougher enemies, and make it to a lot of
new places. Some enemies especially Demon Knights are not affected by it at
all.

subject: Death Necklace
text: The cursed necklace can be found in a Mountain Cave bottom floor chest containing 100-130 gold and sold.

evidence.quote:
Cursed Necklace a.k.a Death Necklace
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Found in the Mountain Cave. On the bottom floor, you will find a chest that
contains 100-130 gold. The cursed necklace is in that chest at random. If it is
not there the first time, chant the spell of Outside, go back in and try again.
Keep trying this until you get it. It may take awhile but you get over 100 gold
